view.title: Inbox
view.subtitle: Items from connected sources and agents that you decide how to handle, across all workspaces. Updates about what happened are in Notifications (the bell, top right); requests nobody has taken on yet are in the Intake tab.
view.empty_description: New items from GitHub, Slack, email, webhooks or manual capture land here. Snooze or archive them, or review the source to turn one into a task.

action.archive_hint: Clears this item from your inbox.
action.snooze_hint: Hide this item for now. It comes back in 1 hour, tomorrow at 9:00, or at 9:00 a week from now (your time zone).

filter.handoff_hint: Show only items where an AI agent stopped and handed the task back to you.

sourceIntake.title: Review source
sourceIntake.acknowledgment_intro: Thanks for sharing this. I’ve captured it for follow-up.
sourceIntake.search_hint: Enter a few words from the task title
sourceIntake.error: Could not complete this source action
sourceIntake.review_hint: Open the original message, then create a task from it or link it to an existing task.
sourceIntake.destination_hint: Create a new task from this source, or link it to a task that already exists. Either way the source is attached to the task as source material.

intake.no_workspace: Join a workspace to start triaging intake items.
intake.empty: No intake items waiting. Add one above, or items sent to this workspace will show up here.

quick_add.hint: Adds a pending item to the selected workspace's queue. It stays an item until you convert it into a task.

convert.title: Convert to task
convert.no_projects: Create a project first to convert intake items.

dismiss.hint: Removes this item from the queue without creating a task.

intake.description: A queue of work that has not been decided yet. Convert an item into a task in a project, or dismiss it.

triage_status.all: With All workspaces selected, AI triage runs on {workspace}. Choose a workspace to triage a different one.
triage_status.nothing: AI triage is unavailable: {workspace} has no inbox items to review.
triage_status.no_workspace: Join a workspace to use AI triage.
